# CLI reference

Reference for `cpe-atlas` version 0.3.0, generated from the
live `argparse` definition so it cannot drift from the actual CLI.
Regenerate after any CLI change with:

```shell
python scripts/generate_cli_reference.py
```

## `cpe-atlas`

```text
usage: cpe-atlas [-h] [--version]
                 {providers,recipes,devices,status,evidence,plan,root-readiness,apply,config-generate,doctor,report-template,redact,firmware-inspect,validate} ...

Firmware-aware catalog and safe research tooling for owner-authorized CPE
access

positional arguments:
  {providers,recipes,devices,status,evidence,plan,root-readiness,apply,config-generate,doctor,report-template,redact,firmware-inspect,validate}
    providers           list cataloged providers
    recipes             list exact device recipes
    devices             list devices published on official ISP pages (not
                        support recipes)
    status              show exact target status
    evidence            show public evidence links
    plan                render a non-mutating decision plan
    root-readiness      check exact-build root evidence without changing a
                        device
    apply               fail-closed mutation entry point; unavailable until a
                        recipe is verified
    config-generate     generate a private offline H3600P config artifact;
                        never flashes a device
    doctor              validate one private target
    report-template     generate a sanitized hardware research template
    redact              redact common secrets and identifying network data
                        from text
    firmware-inspect    hash and scan one private firmware artifact without
                        modifying it
    validate            validate bundled catalog data

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
```

## `cpe-atlas apply`

```text
usage: cpe-atlas apply [-h] --isp ISP --model MODEL
                       --hardware-revision HARDWARE_REVISION
                       --firmware FIRMWARE [--i-own-or-administer-this-device]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --isp ISP             provider ID or name
  --model MODEL         exact device model
  --hardware-revision HARDWARE_REVISION
                        exact hardware revision recorded in the catalog
  --firmware FIRMWARE   exact firmware string
  --i-own-or-administer-this-device
                        acknowledge ownership or explicit authorization
```

## `cpe-atlas config-generate`

```text
usage: cpe-atlas config-generate [-h] --isp ISP --model MODEL
                                 --hardware-revision HARDWARE_REVISION
                                 --firmware FIRMWARE
                                 [--input-config INPUT_CONFIG |
                                 --input-xml INPUT_XML] --output OUTPUT
                                 [--username USERNAME] [--ssh-password-stdin]
                                 [--device-key-stdin] [--serial SERIAL]
                                 [--mac MAC] [--signature SIGNATURE]
                                 [--encrypted | --allow-unencrypted] [--raw]
                                 [--force] [--i-own-or-administer-this-device]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --isp ISP             provider ID or name
  --model MODEL         exact device model
  --hardware-revision HARDWARE_REVISION
                        exact hardware revision recorded in the catalog
  --firmware FIRMWARE   exact firmware string
  --input-config INPUT_CONFIG
                        private existing config.bin baseline; never upload
                        this file
  --input-xml INPUT_XML
                        private decoded XML baseline
  --output OUTPUT       output path for the generated private artifact
  --username USERNAME
  --ssh-password-stdin  read the SSH password from the first stdin line
                        instead of prompting
  --device-key-stdin    read the H3600P device encryption passphrase from
                        stdin when needed
  --serial SERIAL       device serial required to decode or encrypt a type-4
                        artifact
  --mac MAC             lower-case colon-separated device MAC required for
                        type-4 crypto
  --signature SIGNATURE
  --encrypted           emit the device-specific encrypted type-4 container
  --allow-unencrypted   explicitly allow a credential-bearing unencrypted
                        artifact
  --raw                 write raw binary instead of the usual base64 wrapper
  --force
  --i-own-or-administer-this-device
                        acknowledge ownership or explicit authorization
```

## `cpe-atlas doctor`

```text
usage: cpe-atlas doctor [-h] --host HOST [--ports PORTS] [--probe]
                        [--timeout TIMEOUT]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --host HOST        one RFC1918 or IPv6 ULA literal
  --ports PORTS      up to eight explicit TCP ports
  --probe            connect to the listed ports
  --timeout TIMEOUT
```

## `cpe-atlas firmware-inspect`

```text
usage: cpe-atlas firmware-inspect [-h] --input INPUT
                                  [--expected-version EXPECTED_VERSION]
                                  [--expected-sha256 EXPECTED_SHA256] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT         path to a private firmware artifact
  --expected-version EXPECTED_VERSION
                        exact firmware string to check
  --expected-sha256 EXPECTED_SHA256
                        expected SHA-256 hash of the private artifact (64
                        hexadecimal characters)
  --json
```
